segments.text: This is $100,000 and there are four
people behind you. You can decide to
take the money for yourself or you can
split it with them. Your fair share
would be 20 grand, but if you want, you
could just take the whole 100 grand and
then they'd all get $0.
>> Tell me what what do you think?
[music]
>> Sure.
>> What do you mean? You You want all?
>> No, I don't know them. Yeah, I'LL TAKE
ALL IT. [screaming]
>> IF YOU TAKE IT ALL, they'll all get zero
dollars.
>> I understand. Okay.
I guess I've got enough. Give somebody
else a chance.
>> Uh, how do I put this? Um, it's all
gone.
>> How much of this $4,000 do you want?
Zero.
>> What? How does it make you feel that
there's only $4,000 left?
>> I mean, people are greedy.
>> How do you think the two people after
you will feel now? There's only one
grand.
>> I'll take 500 bucks.
>> Thank you. Yep.
>> The four people in front of you decided
to leave you with 500 bucks.
He's got money falling out of his
jacket.
